title: Check the local topology that makes recursive retraction admissible
statement: For the actual planar seed and its natural RX/RZ replacements, every qubit has both check colors, every nonzero X/Z intersection has exactly two qubits/one natural square, and every check link is connected. Cone/suspension and the actual fine-check cases preserve these conditions at every depth, giving the same local face pools/H1 vanishing used by the retraction.

requires: The actual Balasubramanian-Davydova-Lin2605.10943v1 alternating family, fixed odd subdivision ell>=3, natural unique cancellation squares and specified planar seed
All-level size-two X/Z intersections, positive color incidences, connected check links and source degree bounds D7,E4
provides: Accepted analytic admission of the actual family at all levels
assumptions: Not arbitrary LDPC Tanner complexes, larger overlap pairings or disconnected check links
Does not independently acquire the primary random Euclidean embedding, Davies-memory theorem or hardware interactions
A finite-level sampler or rank test is not the all-level admission argument
costs: Constants A,K,p depend on the fixed actual ell/degree bounds, not recursion depth; primary illustrative ell/packing constants enormous
Finite consumers ell3/5 do not acquire random spatial embedding or substitute for primary-qualified ell
Ordinary exact GF2 elimination already fills finite stabilizers in polynomial time; this is a uniform support/generator-count bridge, not a measured finite speedup
contract.units: Exact color incidence/intersection/link topology; all-level family admission distinct from finite matrix controls or geometric acquisition.
contract.obstruction: A superficially similar CSS square complex can lack exactly the local topology consumed by a filling construction.

evidence.range_scope: Governing producer statement; retain the complete source contract and review scope.
